The definition also says 'percentile rank = 1'; do you intend NTILE(10) ordered descending (tile 1) for each score?

The "percentile rank = 1" refers to NTILE(10) ordered descending, so tile 1 represents the top 10%. Artifacts meeting neither criterion ('Other') are excluded, and only those with 'Critical' conservation status are included.

Should 'in a state of emergency' require treatment priority = 'Urgent' as well as conservation status = 'Critical' (the Conservation Emergency definition), or should I filter only on 'Critical' regardless of treatment priority?

Based on the task definition, "state of emergency" refers only to the conservation status being 'Critical'. Treatment priority is not part of the filter, so you should filter on 'Critical' regardless of treatment priority.

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT artref,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY histsignrating DESC) AS historical_tile,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY cultscore DESC) AS cultural_tile
    FROM artifactratings
), classified AS (
    SELECT a.artregistry AS id, a.artname AS name,
           s.insvalueusd AS insured_value, a.conservestatus AS conservation_status,
           CASE WHEN s.insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
                WHEN r.historical_tile = 1 AND r.cultural_tile = 1 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
                ELSE 'Other' END AS category_of_value
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
    JOIN ranked r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
    WHERE a.conservestatus = 'Critical'
)
SELECT id, name, insured_value, conservation_status, category_of_value
FROM classified
WHERE category_of_value <> 'Other';

           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY histsignrating DESC) AS historical_tile,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY cultscore DESC) AS cultural_tile
    FROM artifactratings
), classified AS (
    SELECT a.artregistry AS id, a.artname AS name,
           s.insvalueusd AS insured_value, a.conservestatus AS conservation_status,
           CASE WHEN s.insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
                WHEN r.historical_tile = 1 AND r.cultural_tile = 1 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
                ELSE 'Other' END AS category_of_value
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
    JOIN ranked r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
    WHERE a.conservestatus = 'Critical'
)
SELECT id, name, insured_value, conservation_status, category_of_value
FROM classified
WHERE category_of_value <> 'Other';
